newsitem.title: MONGOLIA: Mongolia's broad M2 up 32.25 pct yr/yr at end-July.
newsitem.headline: Mongolia's broad M2 up 32.25 pct yr/yr at end-July.

text.p: Mongolia's broad M2 money supply rose a year-on-year 32.25 percent to 152.8464 billion tugriks at the end of July, Bank of Mongolia statistics showed on Monday.
M2 rose 10.9 percent at the end of July compared with the end of June, the central bank figures showed.

M1, or cash in circulation plus deposits, rose a year-on-year 32.9 percent at end-July to 75.3832 billion tugriks, bank figures showed. M1 was up 11.4 percent at the end of July compared with end-June, the figures showed.
Cash in circulation, or M0, rose 56.6 percent year-on-year at end-July to 57.2568 billion tugriks, the central bank said. M0 rose 8.5 percent at end-July from end-June.
